capability_labels.AX005-SA004-V001: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for TELECOM.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- network_complaint: Diagnose coverage and speed complaints against live network status and raise a field ticket where warranted.
- recharge_and_plan: Recharge a prepaid number, migrate a plan and explain validity and benefits from the live catalogue.

Business context:
- network_complaint: Indian telecom contact centre. Prepaid recharges, plan migrations, data exhaustion and coverage complaints. Plan changes have cycle rules and network faults have defined resolution windows.
- recharge_and_plan: Indian telecom contact centre. Prepaid recharges, plan migrations, data exhaustion and coverage complaints. Plan changes have cycle rules and network faults have defined resolution windows.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [network_complaint]
  - Known outage first: Where a known outage covers the area, the tool's ETA is quoted and no duplicate ticket is raised.
  - Diagnose before ticket: A line diagnostic must run before a ticket is raised, so the category is evidenced.
  - No coverage promises: The agent must not promise coverage improvement beyond the ticket's stated window.
  - Handset limits: Where the diagnostic reports the handset unsupported, that is stated rather than blamed on the network.
  [recharge_and_plan]
  - Catalogue truth: Only plans returned by list_plans may be offered, with the price and validity the tool returns.
  - Postpaid cycle: A postpaid plan change takes effect from the next billing cycle, never immediately.
  - No benefit invention: Bundled benefits may only be described where the plan record carries them.
  - Balance before recharge: Existing balance and validity must be read before a recharge is recommended.

Tools available to you (7): apply_recharge, check_network_status, list_plans, lookup_subscriber, raise_network_ticket, run_line_diagnostic, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: bn-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: apply_recharge
model_visible_tools.description: Apply a recharge or plan migration to the subscriber.

model_visible_tools.name: check_network_status
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve tower status, known outages and congestion for a location.

model_visible_tools.name: list_plans
model_visible_tools.description: List plans available to this subscriber with price, validity and data.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_subscriber
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve plan, balance, validity, data left and billing cycle position. Read before any recharge is recommended.

model_visible_tools.name: raise_network_ticket
model_visible_tools.description: Raise a field ticket with a resolution window.

model_visible_tools.name: run_line_diagnostic
model_visible_tools.description: Run a remote diagnostic on the subscriber's connection.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Says at the outset how little time they have.
Interrupts a long explanation to ask for the outcome.
Accepts a callback rather than waiting.
Will not sit through an options list.

steps.purpose: Customer reports no signal and expresses time pressure.
steps.text: আমার একটা urgent call আছে, time একদম নেই। সকাল থেকে আমার phone এ কোনো network আসছে না।

steps.purpose: Acknowledge urgency and ask for MSISDN and pincode to check network status.

steps.purpose: Provide MSISDN and pincode.
steps.text: Number টা হলো MSN-2001 আর pincode 411038. একটু fast check করুন।
steps.clean_text: Number টা হলো MSN-2001 আর pincode 411038. একটু fast check করুন।
steps.model_visible_text: Number টা হলো MSN-2010 আর pincode 411038. একটু fast check করুন।

steps.purpose: Clarify the corrupted MSISDN before taking action.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent must confirm the MSISDN because it was corrupted by the STT and is a consequential identifier.
steps.text: আপনার number টা কি MSN-2010 বললেন?
steps.planner_rationale: Clarifying a corrupted reference ID prevents verification failure and ensures the correct line is diagnosed.

steps.purpose: Correct the agent and reiterate urgency.
steps.text: না না, MSN-2001. তাড়াতাড়ি করুন, আমি drive করছি।
steps.clean_text: না না, MSN-2001. তাড়াতাড়ি করুন, আমি drive করছি।
steps.model_visible_text: না না, MSN-2001. তাড়াতাড়ি করুন, আমি drive করছি।

steps.purpose: Verify the customer's identity using the provided pincode.
Return verification outcome.
Acknowledge successful verification and set expectation for the diagnostic.
steps.text: ধন্যবাদ। আপনার details verify হয়ে গেছে। আমি line diagnostic run করছি, just এক minute সময় দিন।

steps.purpose: Agree but press for a quick resolution.
Run diagnostic on the line to establish the category of the fault.
Return diagnostic results.
Convey diagnostic results and transition to checking network status.
steps.text: আমি দেখতে পাচ্ছি আপনার signal strength খুব weak, -115 dBm আসছে। আপনার device supported আছে আর SIM ও registered আছে। আমি আপনার area র network status টা check করছি।

steps.purpose: Check for known outages in the customer's area.
Return network status showing a known fault.
Interrupt to ask for the outcome due to time pressure.
steps.text: কি হলো? কোনো update পেলেন? আমার কিন্তু একটা important meeting আছে।
steps.clean_text: কি হলো? কোনো update পেলেন? আমার কিন্তু একটা important meeting আছে।
steps.model_visible_text: কি হলো? কোনো update পেলেন? আমার কিন্তু একটা important meeting আছে।

steps.purpose: Inform the customer about the known fault and provide the ETA.
steps.text: হ্যাঁ, আপনার area তে একটা network fault আছে। এটা একটা known issue আর ৩ টে tower affected হয়েছে। System অনুযায়ী ETA 6 hours.

steps.purpose: Ask if a ticket needs to be raised, using English technical terms.
steps.text: তাহলে কি কোনো complaint ticket raise করতে হবে আমাকে?
steps.clean_text: তাহলে কি কোনো complaint ticket raise করতে হবে আমাকে?
steps.model_visible_text: তাহলে কি কোনো complaint टिकट raise করতে হবে আমাকে?

steps.purpose: Explain that no ticket is needed due to the known outage, staying in Bengali.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent stays in Bengali despite the English technical terms and STT error in the customer's utterance, and correctly applies the rule not to raise a duplicate ticket.
steps.text: না, আপনাকে আলাদা করে কোনো ticket raise করতে হবে না। এটা already known outage, তাই আমাদের rule অনুযায়ী নতুন ticket দরকার নেই।
steps.planner_rationale: The customer used English domain terms, but the agent must not switch languages; it also enforces BR_NET_01.

steps.purpose: Ask for a forward guarantee about 5G coverage after the outage is fixed.
steps.text: আচ্ছা, 6 hours এর পর কি full speed পাবো? আমার 5G coverage দরকার।
steps.clean_text: আচ্ছা, 6 hours এর পর কি full speed পাবো? আমার 5G coverage দরকার।
steps.model_visible_text: আচ্ছা, 6 hours এর পর কি full speed পাবো? আমার 5G coverage দরকার।

steps.purpose: Refuse to guarantee coverage beyond the tool's resolution window.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent states the 6 hour resolution window but refuses to guarantee 5G coverage after that, as it is not in the tool output.
steps.text: 6 hours এর মধ্যে এই fault টা resolve হয়ে যাবে। কিন্তু 5G coverage এর ব্যাপারে কোনো guarantee আমি দিতে পারছি না, কারণ system এ শুধু এই fault এর resolution time দেওয়া আছে।
steps.planner_rationale: The agent must not make forward guarantees about coverage that the tool didn't return, enforcing BR_NET_03 and Output Grounding.

steps.purpose: Accept the outcome and end the call.
steps.text: ঠিক আছে, তাহলে আমি 6 hours wait করছি। আমি এখন রাখছি।
steps.clean_text: ঠিক আছে, তাহলে আমি 6 hours wait করছি। আমি এখন রাখছি।
steps.model_visible_text: ঠিক আছে, তাহলে আমি 6 hours wait করছি। আমি এখন রাখছি।
